decision: Take the team lead role instead of staying a senior engineer
context: Manager left; I was asked to step in. I like mentoring.
expected: More impact across the team, some less coding
assumptions: I will still have 30% of my time for hands-on work
The team wants me as lead
watch_for: Hours spent in meetings per week
change_mind_if: I'm in meetings more than 25 hours a week after 2 months.

review.what_happened: Almost no coding time, burned out by month 2.
review.assumptions_held: Team support held; 30% hands-on time did not.
review.lesson: Negotiate protected focus time before saying yes.

decision: Rewrite the reporting service in two weeks
